results.name: Battle Rope Double Arm Slams
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart and hold the ends of the battle ropes with a neutral grip. Bend your knees slightly and engage your core.
Raise both arms together to bring the ropes upward, moving through the shoulder joint, while keeping your torso stable.
Forcefully slam both ropes toward the floor by driving your arms downward and slightly hinging at your hips.
Continue repeating the movement with control for the desired duration.
tips: Generate power by driving your arms down forcefully during each slam.
Allow a slight hip hinge to help produce powerful slams.
Keep a consistent rhythm while maintaining good technique.
Inhale as you raise the ropes and exhale as you slam them to the floor.
results.description: Battle Rope Double Arm Slams is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the cardiovascular system (cardio). Performed with a rope, it falls under the cardio category. Secondary muscles: Upper Back, Triceps, Biceps.

results.name: Bear Crawls
instructions: Start on all fours with your hands under your shoulders, your knees under your hips, and your knees slightly off the floor.
Move one hand and the opposite foot forward at the same time while keeping your hips level.
Continue crawling forward with alternating hand and foot movements while maintaining a steady pace, until you complete the desired distance or duration.
tips: Keep your knees just above the floor throughout the exercise.
Keep your hips level and minimize side-to-side movement.
Keep your movements slow and controlled rather than rushing forward.
Maintain a neutral spine and avoid arching or rounding your back.
results.description: Bear Crawls is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Chest, Triceps, Glutes.

results.name: Bent Over Twist
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a straight bar behind your neck with both hands.
Bend forward at the hips, keeping your back straight and your knees slightly bent, until your torso is parallel to the floor.
Twist your torso to one side, bringing one end of the bar towards the ceiling.
Return to the starting position and repeat the movement on the other side.
tips: Keep your spine neutral to avoid unnecessary strain on your back.
Focus on rotating your torso, not just your arms, to ensure you're engaging your obliques effectively.
Maintain even breathing throughout the exercise to help stabilize your core and keep movements fluid.
results.description: Bent Over Twist is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Glutes, Hamstrings.

results.name: Body Slide
instructions: Stand with your feet slightly wider than shoulder-width apart and extend your arms straight out at shoulder level.
Slide your hips to the left, keeping your upper body and arms steady.
Slide your hips to the right, maintaining control and keeping your arms extended.
Continue sliding your hips left and right in a controlled motion.
tips: Engage your core to maintain stability and prevent your upper body from swaying.
Keep your movements smooth and controlled to maximize muscle activation and prevent injury.
Ensure your knees are slightly bent to allow for greater range of motion in your hips.
results.description: Body Slide is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the abductors (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Core, Glutes.

results.name: Body Throw
instructions: Stand tall with your back straight and feet shoulder-width apart, lower your hips to knee level, and extend your arms back at your sides.
Push through your feet and raise yourself upright while raising your heels and extending your arms overhead.
Return to the starting position and repeat.
tips: Engage your core throughout the exercise to maintain balance and proper form.
Use the power from your legs and core to drive the movement, ensuring a controlled and explosive upward motion.
Breathe out as you extend upwards and breathe in as you return to the squat position.
results.description: Body Throw is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Core, Shoulders.

results.name: Bodyweight Front Slam
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and extend your hands overhead.
Swing your arms down forcefully in front of your body, as if slamming a medicine ball to the floor, while simultaneously bending your knees into a squat position.
Return to the starting position with hands extended overhead.
Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Engage your core to maintain stability and control throughout the exercise.
Ensure your back stays straight and avoid rounding your spine when swinging your arms down.
Perform the movement explosively but with control to maximize muscle activation and prevent injury.
results.description: Bodyweight Front Slam is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Quadriceps, Glutes.

results.name: Bodyweight Full Squat With Overhead Front Raise (Version 2)
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms extended in close to your knees.
Lower your body into a squat position until your thighs are parallel to the floor, while simultaneously raising your arms overhead.
Stand back up to the starting position, lowering your arms back close to your knees.
Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Maintain a neutral spine and avoid rounding your back during the exercise to ensure proper form.
Ensure your knees are aligned with your toes during the squat to prevent strain on your knees.
Move at a controlled pace, especially when lifting and lowering your arms, to avoid unnecessary strain and enhance muscle engagement.
results.description: Bodyweight Full Squat With Overhead Front Raise (Version 2) is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Calves.

results.name: Bodyweight Knee Thrust
instructions: Start in a partial lunge position with your left foot forward and right foot back, hands in front of your hips.
Thrust your right knee forward and up to hip level, bringing your hands to meet your knee.
Return to the partial lunge position, lowering your right leg back to the starting position.
Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
tips: Maintain a steady breathing pattern to support balance and coordination during the movement.
Keep your supporting leg slightly bent to absorb impact and provide stability.
Focus on a powerful knee thrust while maintaining proper form and balance.
results.description: Bodyweight Knee Thrust is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Core.

results.name: Bodyweight Knee to Hand Tap
instructions: Start in a standing position with your feet shoulder-width apart and your hands just in front of your hips.
Lift your right knee towards the middle of your hips while lightly rotating your torso to bring your left hand to touch the right knee.
Lower your right leg back to the floor and return your hands to the starting position.
Repeat the movement with your left knee, alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Maintain an upright posture throughout the exercise to ensure proper form.
Rotate your torso smoothly to engage your oblique muscles effectively.
Ensure your knee movement is deliberate and controlled to maximize muscle activation.
Inhale as you lower your leg and exhale as you lift your knee.
results.description: Bodyweight Knee to Hand Tap is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Core.

results.name: Bodyweight Standing Triangle Fly
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and place your hands behind your head, forming a triangle with your bent elbows, elbows facing outwards.
Close your elbows together in front of you, bringing them towards each other.
Open your elbows back out to the sides to return to the starting position.
Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Maintain an upright posture and avoid arching your back during the exercise.
Keep your neck relaxed and avoid pushing your head forward as you bring your elbows together.
Focus on squeezing your chest muscles as you bring your elbows together.
results.description: Bodyweight Standing Triangle Fly is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the pectorals (chest). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Upper Back.
